scripts.build:css: npm run build:css:legacy && npm run build:css:bundles
scripts.check:css: npm run check:architecture && npm run check:contracts && npm run build:css && git diff --check && git diff --exit-code -- assets/css/main.css assets/css/core.css assets/css/panel.css assets/css/status.css assets/css/web.css
scripts.prod:css: sass assets/scss/main.scss assets/css/main.css --style=compressed && postcss assets/css/main.css --use autoprefixer cssnano -o assets/css/main.min.css
scripts.build:css:bundles: sass assets/scss/core.scss assets/css/core.css --no-source-map && sass assets/scss/panel.scss assets/css/panel.css --no-source-map && sass assets/scss/status.scss assets/css/status.css --no-source-map && sass assets/scss/web.scss assets/css/web.css --no-source-map
